review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure (Singapore)
review_candidates.description: Meta is seeking talented engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products, with the mission of connecting billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team and working on exciting projects that have a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Software Engineer, Infrastructure (Singapore) Responsibilities: Lead complex technical efforts across many engineers Set direction and goals for the team regarding project impact, product quality and engineering efficiency Lead major initiatives, projects, teams, roll-outs and phased-releases Interface with other teams to incorporate their innovations and vice versa Proactively identify and drive changes as needed for assigned codebase, product area and/or systems Analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources Design core software components and platforms Conduct design and code reviews Helps onboard new team members, provides mentorship and enables successful ramp up on your team's code bases Code using primarily C/C++ and Python Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant programming language Experience leading major initiatives successfully. Experience leading projects and teams accordingly 6+ years relevant experience building large-scale infrastructure applications or similar experience Experience improving quality through thoughtful code reviews, appropriate testing, proper rollout, monitoring, and proactive changes Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Javascript or Hack Experience building and shipping high quality work and achieving high reliability Experienced in utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and providing detailed feedback and solutions Preferred Qualifications: Experience in programming languages such as C, C++, Java Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies About Meta: Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

review_candidates.title: Backend Engineer (up to £120k)
review_candidates.description: This role is with one of Dex's trusted partner companies. We work closely with their teams to truly understand their culture, goals, and what they're looking for, so we can match you with the right opportunity and give you context about the role before you commit to a process. If you're interested sign up to Dex to apply. Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit. The role This company builds the control plane for data and AI pipelines, used in production by major enterprises. They tackle the core problem of orchestrating complex data and AI workloads, from scheduling to execution and state management. Their new AI agent control plane is where much of the next year's product focus lies. You will own the core orchestration engine: the machinery for scheduling, execution, state, retries, concurrency, and cancellation. This isn't a backend role where you hand off infrastructure or QA; you drive features from idea to production, writing the Terraform and fixing what you ship. You'll design for highly variable load, focusing on capacity, back-pressure, and isolation for systems whose busiest minute looks nothing like their average one. The work Own the core orchestration engine, managing scheduling, execution, state, retries, concurrency, and cancellation. Design and implement robust systems for highly variable load, focusing on capacity, back-pressure, and isolation. Drive features from concept to production, including infrastructure as code (Terraform) and operational monitoring. Build out the AI-native layer, solving novel problems in AI agent orchestration. Deploy to production multiple times a day, maintaining high standards for peer review and CI. What You Bring Deep production experience with Python, making architectural decisions for services, not just scripts. Proven judgment in distributed systems: retries, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, state machines, and debugging production-only race conditions. Treat infrastructure as part of the job; experience with IaC (e.g., Terraform) and serverless architectures in a cloud environment. Strong data modelling instinct, understanding trade-offs between different database paradigms. Bias to shipping: you prioritize impact, distinguishing between quick fixes and problems requiring deeper thought, without over-engineering. Why apply through Dex This is a rare, high-ownership backend role at a company solving genuinely hard problems in data and AI orchestration. Dex helps you cut through the noise: apply once, get matched to this and similar roles, and receive a full brief before any interviews. Skip the cold outreach and get straight to what matters. If you're interested, sign up to Dex to apply - https://jobs.meetdex.ai/jobs/ee71eb07-d22e-4664-87d2-05e64c630b54 As part of the recruitment process at Dex, we process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants. This notice explains how and why your data is collected and used, and how you can contact us if you have any concerns.

review_candidates.title: Automotive Diagnostics & Feature Configuration Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Work Location: Remote Office Location: Gaydon, United Kingdom Experience: 5–10 Years Onsite Requirements: Subject to project requirements Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Automotive Diagnostics & Feature Configuration Software Engineer to develop, integrate, validate, and troubleshoot diagnostic and feature configuration software for automotive platforms. The role requires strong embedded software expertise, diagnostics knowledge, and experience working in Agile development environments. Key Responsibilities Develop, configure, integrate, and validate automotive diagnostics and feature configuration software. Perform issue triage, debugging, vehicle testing, and software integration. Support diagnostic configuration, functionality, and SIMS triage. Investigate software defects, perform root cause analysis, and support corrective actions. Author and review software requirements using structured methods such as EARS. Collaborate with cross-functional teams following Agile methodologies. Maintain software configuration and change management processes. Support verification, validation, and release activities. Required Skills Experience 5-10 yrs in automotive diagnostics, feature configuration, and ISO 14229 (UDS). Proficiency in Embedded C/C++, QNX, MATLAB/Simulink. Hands-on experience with Trace32, CANape, Vector tools, JIRA, and Git. Strong debugging and code-level root cause analysis (Fishbone, 8D). Knowledge of configuration management and software lifecycle. Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
